item.title: Why now is the best time to charter a yacht in the Caribbean
item.description: As the cold winter months arrive, are you dreaming of escaping to a tropical paradise where warm sunshine, crystal-clear waters, and gentle breezes await? Look no further than the Caribbean or Bahamas, where spring is the perfect time to charter a yacht and experience the region’s breathtaking warmth and beauty in all its glory. Warm up in the sun-soaked Caribbean From November to April, the Caribbean enjoys a sweet spot of perfect weather, with mild temperatures ranging from 70-85°F (21-30°C), gentle trade winds, and calm seas. This ideal climate makes it perfect for sailing, snorkeling, diving, and simply soaking up the sun on deck. Imagine waking up each morning to turquoise waters lapping against your yacht’s hull, spending your days exploring hidden coves and secluded beaches, and enjoying spectacular sunsets with friends and family. With our extensive fleet of yachts in a wide range of destinations, you’ll have everything you need to create unforgettable memories in your chosen paradise. Choose your Caribbean paradise Dream Yacht offers more choice of Caribbean and Bahamas destinations than any other charter operator – so you won’t have to compromise on your dream sailing escape. Choose from the British Virgin Islands , Grenada , Guadeloupe , Martinique , and St. Martin , each with its own distinct Caribbean flavors, beauty, and itinerary options. Or choose the Exumas or Abacos out islands of the Bahamas to experience the welcoming culture and charm of these pristine and less-visited island chains. Secure your sunny Caribbean escape Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion or simply seeking an unmatched adventure with loved ones or friends, a Caribbean or Bahamas yacht charter offers something for everyone. Nature lovers will delight in the pristine islands of Exumas or Grenadines. The BVI and Grenada are perfect for those looking to bask in the sun at a beach bar on the perfect stretch of white sand. While St. Martin offers a little of everything with diverse activities and nearby islands to visit. Looking for an authentic, less-visited French Caribbean culture? You can’t go wrong with Guadeloupe or Martinique! So why wait? Escape cold winter blues with a Caribbean yacht charter vacation and take advantage of our last-minute savings on an ultimate tropical getaway this spring. Share: Link Copied to Clipboard

item.title: Meet the Couple Behind Our BVI Crewed Catamaran Allende
item.description: Husband and wife duo, captain Graham Gips and chef Kristiann Gips are in their third season of operating crewed charters in the BVIs on board their yacht Allende, and they don’t do anything halfway. They started sailing a decade ago, while living in Lagos, Nigeria. After racing dinghies and competing internationally, they decided to honor their love of sailing and their passion for hosting guests by running their own charter yacht. We caught up with Kristiann to find out more about Allende , what they offer their customers and why they love their full-time sailing jobs. Life before sailing We used to have very normal lives working in the oil and gas industry. We consider ourselves lucky to have had jobs that sent us traveling internationally, but we secretly craved a life that was more serendipitous. We learned to sail together and now both hold a Master’s 50-ton license from the United States Coast Guard and are CPR/first aid certified. What a typical day looks like Graham spends most of his time sailing the boat, while I keep busy by creating bold-flavored dishes using what is available on and around the island. We also have a huge support staff on shore who help make it all happen, such as people who deliver provisions, to people who clean the boat, for example. What we love about our job Running our own business, working together and having control over the choices you make are the greatest rewards. But that is also the greatest challenge. We are solely responsible for our financial success. It is a very physical job – we love it but it takes a great amount of physical effort on a daily basis. Where our guests love to sail Our guests tend to ask to see The Baths and the Soggy Dollar Bar, but there are certain highlights that are favorites. For guests, we like to find anchorages where we are the only boat. Our crewed yacht is rented by one person for a family vacation or group of friends. The average size tends to be six people and we’ve looked after a huge variety of guests. We see lots of families with young and older kids who are celebrating special occasions, such as milestone anniversaries and birthdays. Why our vacations are so special Listening to what guests are saying and what they aren’t saying is our unique selling point. We make it seamless as an experience – from the moment they land, everything is arranged. Our itineraries work in the same way as our menus, they change depending on diet and preference. Nothing is preset. We work closely with our guests to tailor their vacation entirely to their liking. If you’re new to sailing, we’d love to teach you how much fun it can be. We also have special entertainment on board – our dog, Friday! Allende is a Fountaine Pajot Helia 44 Evolution crewed catamaran with three cabins that can accommodate six passengers sailing between October and August in the Caribbean.
